name: twelfth
title: Twelfth
description: Your Twelfth workspace from Raycast: what to do today, products, projects, and a quick way to ask Twelfth.
author: twelfth

commands.name: today
commands.title: What Should I Do Today
commands.subtitle: Twelfth
commands.description: Your open Twelfth actions, overdue first, then today, this week and later.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Twelfth Today
commands.subtitle: Twelfth
commands.description: Keeps overdue and due-today Twelfth actions in the menu bar.

commands.name: search-products
commands.title: Search Products
commands.subtitle: Twelfth
commands.description: Search your range with stock, cover, sales, GP% and open findings.

commands.name: projects
commands.title: Projects
commands.subtitle: Twelfth
commands.description: Projects in flight, with their stage and overdue tasks.

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask Twelfth
commands.subtitle: Twelfth
commands.description: Start a Twelfth chat with your question.

tools.name: get-open-actions
tools.title: Get Open Actions
tools.description: List the open actions (tasks) in the user's Twelfth workspace, soonest due first, with the workspace's local date so you can tell what is overdue, due today and due later. Use it to answer what the user should do today or what is on their plate.

tools.name: search-products
tools.title: Search Products
tools.description: Search or rank products in the user's Twelfth range with stock on hand, sales velocity, days of cover, units sold, GP%, price, supplier, category and open finding count. Use it to find a product or to rank products, for example by lowest cover or most open findings.

tools.name: list-projects
tools.title: List Projects
tools.description: List the user's Twelfth projects with workflow, stage, owner, open and overdue task counts.

ai.instructions: Twelfth is a retail buying and category-management workspace. All data is read-only. When the user asks what to do today, call get-open-actions and answer in priority order: overdue first, then due today, then the most important of this week. Compare due dates against the workspace's local date (`today`), never your own clock. Keep it short, and include each action's Twelfth link. Figures that are null were not measured; never treat them as zero.

evals.input: @twelfth which products have the lowest cover?

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Workspace API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Leave empty to sign in with your Twelfth account. Owners and admins can create a key in Settings → AI & agents; a key reads the whole workspace.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
